title: The Royal Inscriptions of Amēl-Marduk (561–560 BC), Neriglissar (559–556 BC), and Nabonidus (555–539 BC), Kings of Babylon (RINBE 2)

verification_log.method: Downloaded the open-access PDF from LMU

Introduction n. 46: the Ḫarrān Stele gives Nabonidus ten years in Arabia, the Qumran Prayer of Nabonidus seven years in Tēmā; Nabonidus claims to have begun building projects on instruction received in dreams, "one acceptable means" of divine communication; Nabonidus 3 (Babylon Stele) vi 12′–36′: in a dream Nebuchadnezzar (II) asks Nabonidus to report what he has seen (Jupiter, the moon and Marduk)
